quests.title: Trim one pile down
quests.ask: Write `trim()`: on a cell with a big pile, it leaves exactly one gem behind, however many were there to begin with.
quests.nudge: Picture the pile shrinking. When should the robot stop taking?

quests.title: Every pile along the way
quests.ask: Now a short corridor with piles further along and an empty cell. Each pile should end with one gem, and the empty cell stays empty.
quests.nudge: Which line runs once for every cell the robot steps onto?

quests.title: A pile where you start
quests.ask: This time the robot starts on a pile. That pile should end with one gem too.
quests.nudge: Does the robot ever look at the cell it starts on?
